title: Defining When To Check Replenishment Needs For an Item

Defining When To Check Replenishment Needs For an Item
breadcrumbs: Define When to Check Replenishment Needs for an Item

children: Defining When To Check Replenishment Needs For an Item

A replenishment item criteria record identifies which item(s) you want the system 
 to evaluate for replenishment eligibility when you are running demand-based replenishment 
 for a wave or a pool. When replenishment is attempted for either shipments 
 in the order pool or in a wave, the system uses the this record to define 
 what types of items should be considered for replenishment. This criteria narrows 
 the amount of processing time required to run the replenishment wave step, 
 while ensuring that important items are ready for allocation.

Access the Replenishment Item Criteria Window. Name this record and 
 provide a description.

Using the Filter 
 Data Tab: You can use this tab to specify the values that the system 
 will use to evaluate shipment details in the order pool or in the wave.

Using the Order 
 By Tab: You can use this tab to define the order that items will 
 be organized for possible replenishment.    This 
 tab is optional: you don't have to define this order. If you choose 
 not to address this tab, the system processes through the items in numeric 
 (or alpha) ascending order; for example, it would evaluate item 8001 before 
 item 8002.

When finished, 
 press OK. The system will save your criteria record.
